name: companyregistryapi
description: Access company data across official trade registers.

interface.longDescription: Find source-linked company information from official registers directly in ChatGPT. Use it for private equity, market mapping, M&A and company research. Extendable for researching customers, suppliers and business partners.
capabilities: Search official company registers by name or business ID
Read a company's registry profile by its permanent id: status, legal form, identifiers, industry, lifecycle
defaultPrompt: Which companies have names starting with Volvo in Sweden?
Where is Avast Software s.r.o. registered and what is its legal form and identifiers?
What industry is IKEA of Sweden AB registered in?

positive.description: Search by the start of a name within one headquarters country
positive.prompt: Which companies have names starting with Volvo in Sweden?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_companies with q "Volvo" and country SE and lists companies whose names start with Volvo with headquarters in Sweden, each with its country, and notes that more results exist when next_cursor is set.

positive.description: Registry profile found by name: legal form and identifiers
positive.prompt: Look up Avast Software s.r.o. in the Czech register and show its legal form and identifiers
positive.expected_behavior: Searches "Avast Software" in CZ, reads the company by its permanent id and shows the legal form in the register's own wording (Společnost s ručením omezeným), the identifiers (the Czech registry number 02176475 and the VAT number CZ02176475) and the as-of date.

positive.description: Registry profile found by a business number: industry and classification
positive.prompt: Which company has Estonian registry code 12417834, and what industry does it operate in?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_companies with q "12417834", reads Bolt Technology OÜ by its permanent id and reports the legal form (Private limited company), the industry the register records (Other information technology and computer service activities) and the primary classification (emtak_2025 62901, nace_2025 62.90).

positive.description: Registry profile by a permanent id, without a search
positive.prompt: Show the registry profile for co_2q92ppyj1qb94exkf76tcr3drp
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_company with that id directly and shows Škoda Auto a.s.: its legal form (Akciová společnost), its registry identifiers, that its record is active and the as-of date.

positive.description: Industry of a company found by name
positive.prompt: What industry is IKEA of Sweden AB registered in?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches "IKEA of Sweden" in SE, reads the company by its permanent id and reports the industry the register records (Industridesign och modedesign) and the primary classification (sni_2025 74110, industrial product and fashion design).

negative.description: A calculation on figures the user gives; there is no company to look up
negative.prompt: Calculate the compound annual growth rate if revenue grew from 4.2 million to 6.8 million euros over three years.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call the tools; answers with the calculation itself (about 17.4% a year), and shows no registry data. It may mention that no registry lookup is needed.

negative.description: Guidance on founding a company, which the lookup tools do not cover
negative.prompt: How do I register a new limited company in Finland?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call the tools; answers from general knowledge or points to the Finnish Patent and Registration Office's company registration service, and does not suggest the app can file or register anything.

negative.description: A write operation; there are no write tools
negative.prompt: Update the status of company co_2q92ppyj1qb94exkf76tcr3drp to dissolved
negative.expected_behavior: Declines: the tools only read registers; it points the user to the register that holds the record.

review.commerce_description: The plugin reads public company register data; it sells nothing and takes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: search official company registers by the start of a name or a business ID, and read a company's registry profile by its permanent id: status, legal form, identifiers, industry and lifecycle.
